chronology: Exploratory follow-up; model families were specified before production outcomes. The pooled-source-selected procedure endpoint was clarified while training continued, before inspection of neural effect values. This is not a preregistration.
aggregation: individual validation selectors within target/seed; training seeds within outer target subject
p_value_scope: Conditional working-model diagnostics requiring coordinatewise sign invariance of paired differences. Overlapping fitted source populations are not made independent by aggregation, rank tests, or Holm correction.
multiplicity: Separate planned-size Holm corrections for each of the three new families and each test engine, with Monte Carlo upper-tail sensitivity. Original corrections remain unchanged. Missing MGGL slots are retained in correction arithmetic and never reported as observed tests.
svm_scope: Descriptive absolute outcomes; no added retrospective performance-test family
